role: Principal product engineer and technical lead
objective: Implement the phased MVP of an independent technical chief-of-staff/control-center for AI-built software, combining canonical project state, Blueprint Studio, connected GitHub/Vercel/Supabase intelligence, evidence-backed agent-progress verification, and JSON prompt adapters without becoming an autonomous coding/deployment platform.
product_invariants: Canonical structured project state is authoritative for planned state; generated Markdown is not.
Provider/deterministic evidence is authoritative for observed technical state.
Agent reports are untrusted claims until evaluated against evidence.
AI inference must never be silently promoted to verified truth.
All user-facing prompts are valid JSON and tied to a project revision.
MVP integrations are read-only and cannot automatically edit code, merge, deploy, mutate environments, execute migrations, or write production data.
Credentials, secret values, and production database rows must never enter model context or generated prompts.

phases.goal: Secure tenancy, canonical project model, evidence primitives, design system, jobs, schemas.
Adaptive interview, artifact renderer, design reference intake, screen specs, JSON prompt adapters.
GitHub/Vercel integration, progress verifier, Build Cockpit, Decision Center, next/handoff/recovery prompts.
TypeScript/Next.js deterministic analyzer and grounded code explorer.
Supabase metadata/advisor integration and code-to-database reconciliation.
Map, Risks, Ask, readiness, ETA recalibration, billing, deletion, beta gates.

next_task.goal: Implement Supabase Auth plus durable canonical project persistence as the next vertical slice.
acceptance_criteria: Users can sign in and create a workspace.
Workspace membership is enforced by RLS and server authorization.
Projects can persist canonical revision 1 and append a revision after an accepted decision.
Cross-tenant reads/writes fail in negative tests.
No provider credentials or production data are introduced.
stop_conditions: Stop before adding provider write permissions.
Stop if a proposed shortcut weakens tenant isolation.
Stop before placing service-role credentials in browser-visible code.
